raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4 pre-processes each layer's mHC residual with a single fused op,
`torch.ops.custom.npu_hc_pre` (from `cann-recipes-infer`). **Running DeepSeek-V4
with dual-machine PD disaggregation (prefill/decode separation) on Ascend 950
fails on this path** — `hc_pre` raises an error during the disaggregated run.

<!-- paste the exact error / traceback here once captured -->

Ascend 950 (NPU arch35) also ships the official, CANN-maintained ops
`torch_npu.npu_mhc_pre` + `torch_npu.npu_mhc_sinkhorn`. This PR routes `hc_pre`
through those on 950 to fix the PD-disaggregation failure, while A2/A3 keep the
legacy `custom.npu_hc_pre` path unchanged.


Two API facts shape the implementation:

- The legacy fused op returns `(y, post, comb)`, and its `comb` is already
  Sinkhorn-normalised.
- The official `npu_mhc_pre` returns `h_res` **before** the Sinkhorn transform,
  so `comb` must be produced by chaining `npu_mhc_sinkhorn` (the old op did this
  inline). A naive op-name swap would silently feed a non-normalised `comb` into
  `hc_post`.
<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

1. `python/sglang/kernels/ops/layernorm/mhc.py`
   - `npu_hc_pre` is now an arch dispatcher:
     - On Ascend 950 (`is_npu_arch35()`): `torch_npu.npu_mhc_pre(x, hc_fn, hc_scale, hc_base, gamma=None, norm_eps=rms_norm_eps, hc_eps=hc_eps, out_flag=0)` → `(h_in, h_post, h_res)`, then `torch_npu.npu_mhc_sinkhorn(h_res, eps=hc_eps, num_iters=hc_sinkhorn_iters)` → `comb`. `gamma=None` because the legacy op's RMS is unweighted (the caller applies `input_layernorm` separately).
     - On A2/A3: the legacy `custom.npu_hc_pre` call, **unchanged**.
   - The 4-tuple return contract `(y, post, comb, norm_fused=False)` and the idle/empty short-circuit are preserved.
   - `inner_precise` is intentionally not passed: older `torch_npu` builds do not declare it, and where it exists its default is `0` (FP32).
<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
### Scope note

- **A2/A3 keep the exact legacy path** — they never import `torch_npu`. Only 950 (arch35) takes the new branch.
- `hc_post` is intentionally **not** changed: it already has its own arch35 branch and consumes `(post, comb)`, whose shape/dtype are unchanged. The `custom` extension remains a dependency on 950 (via `custom.npu_hc_post`), which is fine for this change.
- Out of scope (possible follow-up): migrating `hc_post` to `torch_npu.npu_mhc_post`.
## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

@@ -2124,6 +2124,8 @@ def hc_post(
     return out.view(s, -1)
 
 
+# Ascend 950 (NPU arch35, SOC 3510) is the only SKU that ships the official
+# torch_npu mHC ops; A2/A3 keep the fused cann-recipes ``custom.npu_hc_pre``.
 def npu_hc_pre(
     x: torch.Tensor,
     hc_fn: torch.Tensor,
@@ -2135,10 +2137,13 @@ def npu_hc_pre(
     hc_eps: float,
     forward_batch=None,
 ) -> tuple:
-    """NPU-accelerated hc_pre via the custom_ops kernel.
+    """NPU-accelerated hc_pre.
+
+    Ascend 950 (arch35) runs the official ``torch_npu`` ops; every other NPU
+    (A2/A3) keeps the legacy ``custom.npu_hc_pre`` so those SKUs are unaffected.
 
     Returns (y, post, comb, norm_fused).  norm_fused is always False
-    because npu_hc_pre does not fold input_layernorm — the caller must
+    because neither path folds input_layernorm — the caller must
     apply it separately.
     """
     shape, dtype = x.size(), x.dtype
@@ -2160,11 +2165,37 @@ def npu_hc_pre(
         )
         return y, post, comb, False
 
-    # Note the return order: (y, post, comb) — y is the (T, hidden)
-    # mixed activation, post / comb are the hc_post inputs. The
-    # fused kernel emits y in fp32 (sinkhorn iterates in fp32), so
-    # cast back to the input dtype before the downstream
-    # aclnnRmsNorm (which has no x=fp32 / gamma=bf16 overload).
+    # The NPU helper is imported lazily so this kernel module stays free of NPU
+    # backend imports elsewhere.
+    from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.utils import is_npu_arch35
+
+    if is_npu_arch35():
+        # Ascend 950: the official torch_npu ops. npu_mhc_pre emits h_res
+        # *before* the Sinkhorn normalisation, so the doubly-stochastic comb that
+        # hc_post consumes is produced by the separate npu_mhc_sinkhorn op.
+        import torch_npu
+
+        h_in, h_post, h_res = torch_npu.npu_mhc_pre(
+            x,
+            hc_fn,
+            hc_scale,
+            hc_base,
+            gamma=None,
+            norm_eps=rms_norm_eps,
+            hc_eps=hc_eps,
+            out_flag=0,
+        )[:3]
+        # num_iters/eps only; out_flag defaults to 0 and is not exposed on every
+        # torch_npu build's sinkhorn op.
+        sink = torch_npu.npu_mhc_sinkhorn(
+            h_res,
+            eps=hc_eps,
+            num_iters=hc_sinkhorn_iters,
+        )
+        comb = sink[0] if isinstance(sink, (tuple, list)) else sink
+        return h_in.to(dtype), h_post, comb, False
+
+    # A2/A3: the fused cann-recipes op (RmsNorm + GEMM + Sinkhorn in one call).
     y, post, comb = torch.ops.custom.npu_hc_pre(
         x,
         hc_fn,
@@ -2175,9 +2206,8 @@ def npu_hc_pre(
         norm_eps=rms_norm_eps,
         hc_eps=hc_eps,
     )
-    # npu_hc_pre uses norm_eps for sinkhorn's internal RMS only; it does
-    # not fold input_layernorm. Return norm_fused=False so the caller
-    # applies the layernorm itself, matching the deepgemm/torch paths.
+    # The fused op emits y in the sinkhorn fp32 dtype; cast back to the input
+    # dtype before the downstream aclnnRmsNorm (no x=fp32 / gamma=bf16 overload).
     return y.to(dtype), post, comb, False
